hero.text: Clean fades, sharp beards and a style that's all yours. Book your slot, drop by the shop and let us sort you out.

about.title: About us
about.text: Bottega del Taglio was made for people who don't want the usual barber: underground music, neon lights and barbers who follow the trends.
